description: FFmpegKit / ffmpeg-kit, actively maintained. Drop-in replacement for com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-https-gpl (Arthenica's fork, retired April 2025) -- same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, just change the groupId. TLS/https:// URL support (gmp+gnutls) plus GPL encoders (x264/x265/xvidcore/vid.stab). GPL-3.0 -- copyleft applies to your app. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
